Receivables turnover rose from 11.68× to 12.71×. | | **Capital Structure** | Fixed‑asset heavy (≈ 75‑83 % of total assets). Depreciation ≈ 3 % of assets each year. Debt service coverage rose to 3.4× in FY 2024. | | **Litigation** | Two cases filed in 2023 (debt‑recovery and employment claim). Both were **withdrawn**; no outstanding legal exposure reported. | | **Overall Assessment** | Jaya Mega Consulting is a growing, profit‑generating professional‑services firm with a solid cash position, improving liquidity and manageable leverage. The company appears financially stable and positioned for continued expansion in the architectural‑design market. |
